watch.text: Watch how this learner uses the app.

red.text: When the border is red, the learner just listens, and says nothing.

avec_b.text: the border turns green, and the learner says it at the same time as the teacher. Listen to both voices together.

again.text: Again. Together, at the same time.

rep_b.text: the border turns green, and the learner says it once, on their own.

point_b.text: and then points, the border turns green, and the learner says the name, on their own.

only.text: The learner only speaks when the border is green.

yourturn.text: Now it's your turn. Speak clearly and loudly.

q_a.text: Now the teacher asks a question, and answers it herself.

q_b.text: When she asks it again, the border turns green, and the learner says only the answer.

onlyanswer.text: Don't say the question again. Say only the answer.

swamped.text: Put your phone on a flat surface. The microphone is picking up a loud noise.

you_do.text: This is you. When Marie tells you to do something, tap the picture of it, and you'll see yourself do it. Imagine it's really you.

you_do_b.text: Later, Marie will ask you: What are you doing? And: What were you doing? You'll answer as if you had done it yourself.

words.text: What is said is also written. The word with a box round it is the word being said.

underline.text: Letters with a straight line under them, make one sound together.

wavy.text: A wavy line under letters means they don't sound the way you'd expect. Listen to how Marie says them.

lis.text: When Marie says 'Lis', she doesn't say the words. You read the words in the box aloud.

tapmodel.text: Sometimes Marie asks for a picture to be touched. Watch the hand tap it.

tap.text: When this hand appears over the pictures, don't speak. Tap the picture Marie asks for.

count.text: A hand touches each thing in turn, and Marie says a number at each touch.

count_you.text: Now it's your turn to count. Say one number each time the hand touches a thing.

asker.text: Sometimes Pierre or Sylvie asks the question. The green ring shows who is asking, and its tail points to the one who must answer. A hand on their own name tag means the question is about them.

lis_b.text: she doesn't say the words. You read the words in the box aloud.

you_do_c.text: For example, if she asks, What are you doing? you answer, I am dancing. If she asks, What were you doing? you answer, I was dancing.

count_you_b.text: it is the turn of the person she is talking to. They count, saying one number each time the hand touches a thing.
